## Client operations by domain

### Account

account-level settings

| Method | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `AcceptTermsOfService` | AcceptTermsOfService accepts a pending terms-of-service revision, as returned by GetTermsOfServiceUpdate. |
| `GetAccountTTL` | GetAccountTTL returns the number of days after which the account will self-destruct if the user does not log in. |
| `GetGlobalPrivacySettings` | GetGlobalPrivacySettings returns the current global privacy settings for the account. |
| `GetPrivacy` | GetPrivacy returns the current privacy rules for the given privacy key. |
| `GetTermsOfServiceUpdate` | GetTermsOfServiceUpdate returns the pending terms-of-service revision the logged-in user has not accepted yet, or nil when the current terms are already accepted. |
| `SetAccountTTL` | SetAccountTTL sets the number of days after which the account will self-destruct if the user does not log in. |
| `SetGlobalPrivacySettings` | SetGlobalPrivacySettings applies the given global privacy settings to the account. |
| `SetPrivacy` | SetPrivacy sets the privacy rules for the given privacy key. |

### Advanced

raw RPC escape hatches

| Method | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `ConnectionSnapshot` | ConnectionSnapshot returns transport and connection lifecycle diagnostics. |
| `InvokeJSON` | InvokeJSON sends a raw Telegram API call encoded as JSON. |
| `LoadSnapshot` | LoadSnapshot returns an aggregated view of the client's internal load state. |
| `RPC` | RPC is an alias for [Client.Raw]. |
| `Raw` | Raw returns a low-level tg.RPCClient that sends TL objects directly to the Telegram server. |

### Auth

authorization

| Method | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `ChangePhoneNumber` | ChangePhoneNumber completes a phone-number change with the code delivered to the new number and returns the updated user. |
| `CheckPassword` | CheckPassword completes authentication for an account that has two-factor authentication (2FA) enabled. |
| `CheckQRCodeLoginToken` | CheckQRCodeLoginToken checks whether the given token has been scanned by an authenticated Telegram client. |
| `GetActiveSessions` | GetActiveSessions retrieves all active sessions for the currently authorized account. |
| `GetPasswordHint` | GetPasswordHint retrieves the optional hint string configured for the account's two-factor authentication password. |
| `GetQRCodeLoginToken` | GetQRCodeLoginToken requests a new QR code login token from Telegram. |
| `RecoverPassword` | RecoverPassword authenticates the user using a recovery code sent to the account's recovery email address. |
| `ResendPhoneNumberCode` | ResendPhoneNumberCode re-requests the verification code for an ongoing sign-in, typically to deliver it through the next code type (for example from SMS to a phone call). |
| `ResetSession` | ResetSession terminates a specific session identified by its hash. |
| `SendChangePhoneNumberCode` | SendChangePhoneNumberCode starts a phone-number change by requesting a verification code for the new number. |
| `SendPhoneNumberCode` | SendPhoneNumberCode requests Telegram to send a verification code to the given phone number. |
| `SignIn` | SignIn authenticates a user with the phone number, verification code, and the phone code hash returned by SendPhoneNumberCode. |
| `SignOut` | SignOut logs the current session out of Telegram and disconnects the client from the server. |
| `SignUp` | SignUp registers a new Telegram account for a phone number that is not yet associated with any account. |

### Bots

bot surface

| Method | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `AllowBotToMessage` | AllowBotToMessage grants the given business bot permission to message the logged-in user. |
| `AnswerCallbackQuery` | AnswerCallbackQuery sends an answer to a callback query originated from an inline button press. |
| `AnswerGuestQuery` | AnswerGuestQuery sends an inline result as a reply to a received guest message. |
| `AnswerInlineQuery` | AnswerInlineQuery sends results for an inline query originated from the @bot search box. |
| `AnswerWebAppQuery` | AnswerWebAppQuery sends the result of an interaction with a Web App to the Telegram server. |
| `AnswerWidgetQuery` | AnswerWidgetQuery answers a widget query issued by a widget message of the logged-in bot. |
| `CanMessageBot` | CanMessageBot reports whether the logged-in user may message the given business bot. |
| `DeleteBotCommands` | DeleteBotCommands resets (deletes) all bot commands for the given scope and language code. |
| `GetBotCommands` | GetBotCommands retrieves the current list of bot commands for the specified language code. |
| `GetBotInfoDescription` | GetBotInfoDescription retrieves the bot's long description text for the specified language code. |
| `GetBotInfoShortDescription` | GetBotInfoShortDescription retrieves the bot's short "about" text for the specified language code. |
| `GetBotName` | GetBotName retrieves the bot's display name for the specified language code. |
| `GetBotRecommendations` | GetBotRecommendations returns bots recommended alongside the given bot. |
| `GetBotUserMenuButton` | GetBotUserMenuButton returns the menu button a specific user sees for the logged-in bot. |
| `GetChatMenuButton` | GetChatMenuButton returns the current menu button configured for the specified user. |
| `GetGameHighScores` | GetGameHighScores returns the high score table for a game message. |
| `GetInlineBotResults` | GetInlineBotResults requests inline results from a bot for the given query. |
| `GetOwnedBots` | GetOwnedBots lists the bots created by the logged-in user. |
| `GetPopularAppBots` | GetPopularAppBots searches popular mini-app bots by query. |
| `InvokeWebViewCustomMethod` | InvokeWebViewCustomMethod invokes a custom mini-app method on behalf of the logged-in mini app with the given bot. |
| `ReorderBotUsernames` | ReorderBotUsernames changes the display order of an owned bot's active usernames. |
| `RequestCallbackAnswer` | RequestCallbackAnswer requests the bot's callback answer for a message in a chat. |
| `SendInlineBotResult` | SendInlineBotResult sends a specific inline bot result to a chat. |
| `SetBotCommands` | SetBotCommands sets the list of bot commands for the given scope and language code. |
| `SetBotDefaultAdminRights` | SetBotDefaultAdminRights sets the default administrator rights the logged-in bot requests when added to channels (forChannels true) or groups. |
| `SetBotInfoDescription` | SetBotInfoDescription sets the bot's long description text for the specified language code. |
| `SetBotInfoShortDescription` | SetBotInfoShortDescription sets the bot's short "about" text for the specified language code. |
| `SetBotName` | SetBotName sets the bot's display name for the specified language code. |
| `SetBotUserMenuButton` | SetBotUserMenuButton sets the menu button a specific user sees for the logged-in bot. |
| `SetChatMenuButton` | SetChatMenuButton sets the menu button for the specified user in the bot's chat. |
| `SetGameScore` | SetGameScore sets the game score for the specified user in a game message. |
| `ToggleBotUsername` | ToggleBotUsername activates or deactivates one of an owned bot's usernames. |

### Business

business profile and links

| Method | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `CreateBusinessChatLink` | CreateBusinessChatLink creates a new chat link for the logged-in business account from the given link definition. |
| `DeleteBusinessChatLink` | DeleteBusinessChatLink deletes a business chat link by its slug. |
| `EditBusinessChatLink` | EditBusinessChatLink replaces the definition of an existing business chat link, identified by its slug. |
| `GetBusinessChatLinks` | GetBusinessChatLinks lists the chat links configured for the logged-in business account. |
| `GetBusinessConnection` | GetBusinessConnection retrieves a business connection by its ID. |
| `ResolveBusinessChatLink` | ResolveBusinessChatLink resolves a business chat link slug and returns the destination peer and greeting message. |
| `SetBusinessAwayMessage` | SetBusinessAwayMessage sets the automated away message sent while the business account is closed. |
| `SetBusinessGreetingMessage` | SetBusinessGreetingMessage sets the automated greeting message sent to new business chats. |
| `SetBusinessIntro` | SetBusinessIntro sets the intro new customers see when opening the business chat. |
| `SetBusinessLocation` | SetBusinessLocation sets the business location shown on the logged-in user's profile. |
| `SetBusinessWorkHours` | SetBusinessWorkHours sets the logged-in user's business opening hours shown on their profile. |

### Contacts

contact book

| Method | Purpose |

| Method | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `GetExistingWalletBalance` | GetExistingWalletBalance checks whether the logged-in user already owns a TON balance on an external wallet, returning the URL to import it. |
| `GetWalletNFTs` | GetWalletNFTs lists the NFTs held by the wallet. |
| `GetWalletState` | GetWalletState returns the TON wallet state of the logged-in user: address, balance, and backup capability. |
| `GetWalletTransactions` | GetWalletTransactions lists the wallet's transaction history. |
| `GetWalletTransactionsByIDs` | GetWalletTransactionsByIDs fetches specific wallet transactions by their identifiers. |
| `GetWalletTransactionsByMessageHash` | GetWalletTransactionsByMessageHash fetches wallet transactions referenced by external message hashes. |
| `GetWalletUserAddresses` | GetWalletUserAddresses resolves wallet addresses for users, or users for addresses. |
| `SendWalletTransfer` | SendWalletTransfer submits a signed TON transfer to the wallet. |

## Bound methods by type

Types constructed by the client carry a minimal binder so their convenience methods
work without a client reference. Every bound method has a `NameContext` explicit-context
form; only the convenience forms are listed.
